name: Create-a-Park
author: Project 8 Plus
description: Build skate parks in the game with the pad: in free skate hold L1 + R1 and press Triangle. Needs the Creator tools add-on (Setup); the P8Plus launcher starts the Create-a-Park companion with the game. Parks are saved in Documents\P8Plus Mods; the park build the game plays (mods\zz_cap) is removed at the next normal start.
